title: InstantiateMsg
description: Message used to instantiate the node families contract.

Config.description: Runtime configuration of the node families contract.

create_family_fee.description: Fee charged on each successful `create_family` execution.

default_invitation_validity_secs.description: Default lifetime, in seconds, used by `invite_to_family` when the sender doesn't supply an explicit value. Senders may override this per-invitation via the optional `validity_secs` argument.

family_description_length_limit.description: Maximum allowed length, in characters, of a family description.

family_name_length_limit.description: Maximum allowed length, in characters, of a family name.
